decisions.decision: The Board wants the application altered to a single-phase, one-rink project with a modified parking lot; the applicant returns for a modification at construction of the second rink; the current requested waivers remain.
decisions.quote: the board would like to see this application altered to be a single phase one-rink project with a modified parking lot and that r. breau return to the board for a modification at the time of construction of the second rink

decisions.decision: The Board requested a landscape plan from the applicant.
The lighting and photometric plan will be part of the modification for the second rink.
decisions.quote: the lighting and photometric plan would be part of the modification for the second rink.
